Ooredoo prolonge le délai de participati: Ooredoo extends the participation deadline for the Media Star contest
Fidèle à son engagement en faveur de l'e: True to its commitment to journalistic excellence and eager to provide media professionals with the best conditions for participation, Ooredoo Algeria announces the extension of the submission deadline for the 19th edition of the Media Star contest, now set for August 31, 2026.
Cette décision intervient à la suite des: This decision follows numerous requests from journalists wishing to benefit from additional time to finalize their work. After reviewing these requests and with the approval of the jury members, Ooredoo has decided to grant this exceptional extension, thus offering a greater number of media professionals the opportunity to finalize their work, publish it, or broadcast it in their respective outlets.
Les journalistes pourront ainsi concouri: Journalists can thus compete with works produced in Arabic, Tamazight, French, or English, published or broadcast in Algerian media between August 15, 2025, and August 31, 2026.
Pour rappel, cette 19ème édition de Medi: As a reminder, this 19th edition of Media Star is dedicated to a major current theme, namely: "The impact of artificial intelligence and 5G technology on socio-economic transformations in Algeria".
